0022600135.text: The 3-0 Philadelphia 76ers, first in the Atlantic and second in the East with a three-game winning streak, visit the 2-1 Indiana Pacers, who are fifth in the East and half a game behind the Central Division leader, in this regular-season game, the 76ers' fifth of the season. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid, Tacko Fall and VJ Edgecombe, while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard and Johnny Furphy. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Philadelphia won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
